articles.title: SharkNinja set for S&P 500 entry in wave of deal-driven index changes
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Sharkninja Inc (NYSE:SN) is set to join the benchmark S&P 500 next week as part of a broader index reshuffle triggered by pending corporate acquisitions. S&P Dow Jones Indices announced Monday that the consumer appliance maker will replace The AES Corporation (NYSE:AES) prior to the market open on Wednesday, December 2, lifting SharkNinja shares 2.1% in after-hours trading.
